summary: Added environment repository scaffold CLIs, target/backend OpenTofu variable propagation, and local/GitHub Actions/AWS scaffold validation graphs.

assertions: scaffold-tf-env.py creates a starter environment repo that can be initialized as Git during tests.
scaffold-env.py can add local.tf, aws.tf, and local-github-action.tf style templates to one repository without clobbering existing environments.
Generated templates expose EnvironmentId, KUBECONFIG, and KUBECONTEXT outputs.
Tests create a temporary Git repository with git init/add/commit instead of checking in a nested repository or tarball fixture.
The test graph validates the generated environment repository contract for local, GitHub Actions, and AWS templates.

The existing environmentRepositoryContract graph is updated or extended to consume the newly scaffolded environment repository path, so scaffold output becomes the primary fixture for later lifecycle graphs.
evidence: scripts/scaffold-tf-env.py and scripts/scaffold-env.py create Git-ready OpenTofu environment repositories and target templates.
project_sdk_sources/build-logic exports TF_VAR_target and TF_VAR_backend to environment repository commands.
environmentRepositoryScaffoldLocal consumes the scaffolded repository as the local runtime fixture.
environmentRepositoryScaffoldGithubAction and environmentRepositoryScaffoldAws validate target-specific scaffold structure and metadata without provisioning cloud resources.
